# 大廣益會玉篇-宋

**ID:** KR1j0056
**Custom ID:** SB11n024
**Date (file):** 2015-09-10 23:06:54.151761
**Extent:** 三十卷
**Base edition:** SBCK

## Authors / Editors
- 陳彭年 (宋朝) 等奉勅重修

**Editions:** SBCK

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Sìbù cóngkān* (SBCK) reprint of the imperially-revised Northern-Sòng *Yùpiān* — i.e., the same imperial recension treated under [KR1j0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0022) (*Chóngxiū Yùpiān*, WYG version) but bearing its alternative Sòng-period title *Dàguǎng yìhuì Yùpiān*. The dictionary covers 30 *juàn* under 540 *bùshǒu*, transmitting the Liáng-period *Yùpiān* (543) of Gù Yěwáng [顧野王](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A1%A7%E9%87%8E%E7%8E%8B) in the Northern-Sòng recension produced by Chén Péngnián, Wú Ruì 吳銳, Qiū Yōng [丘雍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%98%E9%9B%8D) and others on imperial command (Dàzhōngxiángfú 6 / 1013). The SBCK base is the Yuán-Míng print line preserving the Sòng *Dàguǎng yìhuì* title — distinct from Zhāng Shìjùn's later print which (per the Sìkù tíyào discussion under [KR1j0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0022)) wrongly claimed *Shàngyuán*-edition status while in fact transmitting the same Sòng *chóngxiū* text. The work is the second great Chinese character dictionary after the *Shuōwén jiězì*; for the full bibliographic entry — provenance, Liáng/Táng/Sòng layered transmission, Shén Gǒng's *Wǔyīn shēnglùn* / *fǎnniǔtú* appendices, modern critical editions — see [KR1j0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0022).

**Abstract**

This entry is the SBCK transmission of the same *Yùpiān* recension treated more fully at [KR1j0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0022). The SBCK base text descends from the Yuán-Míng print line which preserved the Northern-Sòng imperial title *Dàguǎng yìhuì Yùpiān* — referring to Chén Péngnián's [陳彭年](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E5%BD%AD%E5%B9%B4) re-edition of Dàzhōngxiángfú 6 (1013) which substantially expanded the Liáng-period text of Gù Yěwáng [顧野王](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A1%A7%E9%87%8E%E7%8E%8B) (presented 543) and the Táng-period augmentation by Sūn Qiáng (Shàngyuán 1, 674). The Sìkù imperial editors recognised this version as the one preserved in the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn* and used by Yuán-period scholars. *notBefore* = *notAfter* = 1013, the year of Chén Péngnián's revision.
